'''Resh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sluissi]] and the sister of [[Hass Sonax]]. Resh and Hass signed onto a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to fulfill two temporary maintenance positions but quickly came to see the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] disdain for [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and were treated as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. After a faulty [[fusion coil]] blew and caused a thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] mission delay, Resh was executed in cold blood by the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="J15" />
